incidents.name: Sodium session-key validation bypass
incidents.notes: Sodium's executeWithSodiumAuthSession signature path accepted an attacker-chosen session key with no owner authorization proof, letting forged user operations consume more than 300 wallets' EntryPoint gas deposits.

sources.ref: verified Sodium implementation deployed by 0x0f369f61983cb0c4a432e4a81aaaa24f2d48be45 in tx 0x259d0c343896630f0a94cd7d4ff69fd489d424618368aa362a37b9662e21cce4; sampled victim wallets pointed to it before the attack
